title: 食堂のいちばん忙しい時間
summary: 食堂は 1 階が 730 席、2 階が 665 席。昼のピークに牛乳が切れたらしい。共創棟 1 階のファミリーマートで牛乳を買って、中川かなめのところへ持っていく。
summary_en: The cafeteria has 730 seats on the first floor and 665 on the second. At the lunch peak, they've run out of milk. Buy milk at the convenience store on the first floor of Kyoso Hall and bring it to Nakagawa Kaname.
rewardText: かなめが日替わりを一皿おまけしてくれた
rewardText_en: Kaname threw in an extra plate of the daily special

steps.text: 共創棟 1 階のファミリーマートで牛乳を買う
steps.text_en: Buy milk at the convenience store on the first floor of Kyoso Hall

steps.text: 1 階の食堂のかなめに届ける
steps.text_en: Deliver it to Kaname in the first-floor cafeteria
